```go
func (p *printer) write(v reflect.Value, indent int) {
	if !v.IsValid() {
		p.sb.WriteString("nil")
		return
	}
	// unwrap interface
	if v.Kind() == reflect.Interface {
		if v.IsNil() {
			p.sb.WriteString("nil")
			return
		}
		p.sb.WriteString(v.Type().String())
		p.sb.WriteString("(")
		p.write(v.Elem(), indent)
		p.sb.WriteString(")")
		return
	}

	switch v.Kind() {
	case reflect.Bool:
		p.sb.WriteString(strconv.FormatBool(v.Bool()))
	case reflect.Int, ...:
		p.sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%d", v.Int()))
	case reflect.Uint...:
		p.sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%d", v.Uint()))
	case reflect.Float32, reflect.Float64:
		p.sb.WriteString(strconv.FormatFloat(v.Float(), 'g', -1, v.Type().Bits()))
	case reflect.Complex64, reflect.Complex128:
		...
	case reflect.String:
		p.sb.WriteString(strconv.Quote(v.String()))
	case reflect.Ptr:
		p.writePtr(v, indent)
	case reflect.Struct:
		p.writeStruct(v, indent)
	case reflect.Slice, reflect.Array:
		p.writeSlice(v, indent)
	case reflect.Map:
		p.writeMap(v, indent)
	case reflect.Chan:
		...
	case reflect.Func:
		...
	case reflect.UnsafePointer:
		...
	default:
		// fallback
		if v.CanInterface() {
			p.sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%#v", v.Interface()))
		} else {
			p.sb.WriteString(v.Type().String())
		}
	}
}
```

func (p *printer) writeStruct(v reflect.Value, indent int) {
	t := v.Type()
	p.sb.WriteString(t.Name()) // empty for anonymous
	p.sb.WriteString("{")
	n := v.NumField()
	if n == 0 { p.sb.WriteString("}"); return }
	p.newline(indent+1)
	for i:=0;i<n;i++ {
		f := t.Field(i)
		p.sb.WriteString(f.Name)
		p.sb.WriteString(": ")
		p.write(fieldValue(v.Field(i)), indent+1)
		if i < n-1 { p.sb.WriteString(",") }
		p.newline(indent+1) // careful

	p.sb.WriteString("}")
}
```

func (p *printer) writePtr(v reflect.Value, indent int) {
	if v.IsNil() {
		p.sb.WriteString("(" + v.Type().String() + ")(nil)")

	}

	if p.seen[key] {

		return

	p.sb.WriteString("&")

func (p *printer) writeSlice(v reflect.Value, indent int) {
	t := v.Type()
	if v.Kind()==reflect.Slice && v.IsNil() {
		p.sb.WriteString(t.String()+"(nil)")
		return
	}
	// cycle detection for slices
	var key visit
	cyclic := false
	if v.Kind()==reflect.Slice && v.Len()>0 {
		key = visit{t, v.Pointer()}
		if p.seen[key] { p.sb.WriteString("<cycle "+t.String()+">"); return }
		p.seen[key]=true; cyclic=true
		defer func(){ if cyclic { delete(p.seen,key) } }()
	}
	p.sb.WriteString(t.String())
	p.sb.WriteString("{")
	for i:=0;i<v.Len();i++ {
		p.newline(indent+1)
		p.write(v.Index(i), indent+1)
		p.sb.WriteString(",")
	}
	if v.Len()>0 { p.newline(indent) }
	p.sb.WriteString("}")
}
```

```go
// Package debugprint provides a reflection-based pretty-printer for
// inspecting arbitrary Go values. Unlike fmt's %#v verb, it expands
// nested values across multiple indented lines and detects reference
// cycles so that recursive data structures terminate.
package debugprint

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

const indentUnit = "  "

type visit struct {
	typ reflect.Type
	ptr uintptr
}

type printer struct {
	sb   strings.Builder
	seen map[visit]bool
}

func Sprint(vals ...interface{}) string {
	p := printer{seen: make(map[visit]bool)}
	for i, v := range vals {
		if i > 0 {
			p.sb.WriteByte(' ')
		}
		p.write(reflect.ValueOf(v), 0)
	}
	return p.sb.String()
}

func Sprintln(vals ...interface{}) string {
	return Sprint(vals...) + "\n"
}

func Fprint(w io.Writer, vals ...interface{}) (int, error) {
	return io.WriteString(w, Sprint(vals...))
}

func Fprintln(w io.Writer, vals ...interface{}) (int, error) {
	return io.WriteString(w, Sprintln(vals...))
}

func Print(vals ...interface{}) (int, error) {
	return Fprint(os.Stdout, vals...)
}

func Println(vals ...interface{}) (int, error) {

func (p *printer) write(v reflect.Value, indent int) {
	if !v.IsValid() {
		p.sb.WriteString("nil")
		return
	}
	switch v.Kind() {
	case reflect.Bool:
		p.sb.WriteString(strconv.FormatBool(v.Bool()))
	case reflect.Int, reflect.Int8, reflect.Int16, reflect.Int32, reflect.Int64:
		p.sb.WriteString(strconv.FormatInt(v.Int(), 10))
	case reflect.Uint, reflect.Uint8, reflect.Uint16, reflect.Uint32, reflect.Uint64, reflect.Uintptr:
		p.sb.WriteString(strconv.FormatUint(v.Uint(), 10))
	case reflect.Float32, reflect.Float64:
		p.sb.WriteString(strconv.FormatFloat(v.Float(), 'g', -1, v.Type().Bits()))
	case reflect.Complex64, reflect.Complex128:
		c := v.Complex()
		p.sb.WriteString(strconv.FormatFloat(real(c), 'g', -1, v.Type().Bits()/2))
		p.sb.WriteString(complexSign(imag(c)))
		p.sb.WriteString(strconv.FormatFloat(imag(c), 'g', -1, v.Type().Bits()/2))
		p.sb.WriteString("i")
	case reflect.String:
		p.sb.WriteString(strconv.Quote(v.String()))
	case reflect.Interface:
		if v.IsNil() {
			p.sb.WriteString("nil")
			return
		}
		p.sb.WriteString(v.Type().String())
		p.sb.WriteByte('(')
		p.write(v.Elem(), indent)
		p.sb.WriteByte(')')
	case reflect.Ptr:
		p.writePtr(v, indent)
	case reflect.Struct:
		p.writeStruct(v, indent)
	case reflect.Slice, reflect.Array:
		p.writeSlice(v, indent)
	case reflect.Map:
		p.writeMap(v, indent)
	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Func:
		p.writeRef(v)
	case reflect.UnsafePointer:
		p.sb.WriteString(v.Type().String())
		p.sb.WriteByte('(')
		p.sb.WriteString(strconv.FormatUint(uint64(v.Pointer()), 16))
		p.sb.WriteByte(')')
	default:
		p.fallback(v)
	}
}
```

func (p *printer) writePtr(v reflect.Value, indent int) {
	if v.IsNil() {
		p.sb.WriteString(v.Type().String())
		p.sb.WriteString("(nil)")
		return
	}
	key := visit{v.Type(), v.Pointer()}
	if p.seen[key] {
		p.sb.WriteString("<cycle ")
		p.sb.WriteString(v.Type().String())
		p.sb.WriteString(">")
		return

	p.sb.WriteByte('&')
	p.write(v.Elem(), indent)

		p.write(k, indent+1)

		p.write(v.MapIndex(k), indent+1)
		p.sb.WriteByte(',')

	if len(keys) > 0 {
		p.newline(indent)
	}
	p.sb.WriteByte('}')
}
